### (b) Find similar bundles using geometric models of similarity:
### (i) Create cosine-similarity based recommendations for a given bundle
### 1. Create a cosine_sim(a, b) function that returns the cosine similarity of two vectors.
```{R}
# load the PicCollage bundle data
ac_bundles <- read.csv("piccollage_accounts_bundles.csv", header = TRUE)

# remove the first column (account_id) and keep only bundle usage counts
items_matrix <- as.matrix(ac_bundles[, -1])

# cosine similarity between two vectors
cosine_sim <- function(a, b) {
  sum(a * b) / (sqrt(sum(a^2)) * sqrt(sum(b^2)))
}
```
\begin{answerbox}
The cosine similarity between two vectors is the dot product divided by the product of their magnitudes. A higher value means the two bundles have more similar usage patterns across accounts.
\end{answerbox}

### 2. Create a cosine_recos(items_matrix, item_name) function that takes a matrix of items and the name of a specific item you are interested in, and returns five (5) recommendations for that item based on cosine similarity.
```{R}
# return the top 5 most similar bundles to item_name
cosine_recos <- function(items_matrix, item_name) {
  # extract the column vector of the chosen bundle
  item_vector <- items_matrix[, item_name]
  
  # compute cosine similarity between the chosen bundle and every bundle
  sims <- apply(items_matrix, 2, function(x) cosine_sim(x, item_vector))
  
  # remove the bundle itself from the recommendation list
  sims <- sims[names(sims) != item_name]
  
  # sort from highest similarity to lowest
  sims <- sort(sims, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # return the top 5 bundle names
  top_names <- names(sims)[1:5]
  return(top_names)
}
```

### 3. Top 5 cosine recommendations for happycny2016
```{R}
chosen_bundle <- "happycny2016"

cosine_top5 <- cosine_recos(items_matrix, chosen_bundle)
cosine_top5
```

### (ii) Create correlation based recommendations:
```{R}
# mean-center each bundle column
bundle_means <- apply(items_matrix, 2, mean)

# repeat the bundle means for each row
bundle_means_matrix <- t(replicate(nrow(items_matrix), bundle_means))

# column-mean-centered matrix
items_matrix_mc_col <- items_matrix - bundle_means_matrix

# reuse the same recommendation function
cor_top5 <- cosine_recos(items_matrix_mc_col, chosen_bundle)
cor_top5
``` 

### (iii) Create an adjusted-cosine based recommendations.
```{R}
# mean-center each account row
account_means <- apply(items_matrix, 1, mean)

# repeat the account means for each column
account_means_matrix <- matrix(account_means,
                               nrow = nrow(items_matrix),
                               ncol = ncol(items_matrix),
                               byrow = FALSE)

# row-mean-centered matrix
items_matrix_mc_row <- items_matrix - account_means_matrix

# reuse the same recommendation function
adjcos_top5 <- cosine_recos(items_matrix_mc_row, chosen_bundle)
adjcos_top5
```
